title: SiteIndexEntry
description: Shape of each entry in data/site-index.json's 'items' array — a flattened, site-sized view merging data/jobs-global.json and data/public-opportunities.json into one list. This is a read projection for a future frontend, not a new source of truth: every field here is copied from a JobEntry or PublicEntry record (see config/job-entry.schema.json / config/public-entry.schema.json), never invented. Fields that only exist on one origin layer (e.g. 'category', 'country', 'remote_type' are curated-only) are omitted entirely rather than filled in with a guessed value when absent.

id.description: 16-char hex ID, carried over unchanged from the source record

kind.description: 'job' for every data/jobs-global.json entry and every kind:'job' public entry; 'hackathon'/'event' pass straight through from the public layer

origin.description: Which pipeline layer produced this entry — data/jobs-global.json ('curated') or data/public-opportunities.json ('public')

location.description: Single-line display string. For a multi-location posting this is a short summary ('Seattle, WA +6 more'); the full list is in 'locations'. Never contains HTML.

locations.description: Present only for a multi-location posting — the individual locations, unpacked from the curated layer's README dropdown so the UI can render its own control

level.description: Job-only. Curated records use the 6-value JobEntry taxonomy; public records add 'other'

category.description: Job-only, curated-origin only — the allowlist category matched (e.g. 'faang'), or '' for a relaxed-mode fallback match. Public-origin job entries never have this key, since the public layer isn't allowlist-gated

remote_type.description: Job-only, curated-origin only — the public layer doesn't detect this

age.description: Human-readable age for jobs, submission deadline for hackathons, or '' for events — unified from JobEntry.age / PublicEntry.date

posted_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or '' when the source only exposes a fuzzy relative date (see 'age' instead)

url.description: Link to the posting — always an absolute URL. Unlike PublicEntry.url, Luma's site-relative event paths (e.g. '/some-event?k=c') are already resolved to 'https://lu.ma/...' here, so no consumer of this file needs source-specific URL handling

tech_tags.description: Job-only. Canonical tech/skill tags explicitly named in the posting text, from scripts/patterns.py detect_tech_tags. Absent when no description text was available or nothing matched — never guessed. Currently populated for public-origin jobs from ATS layers that expose a description (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby); other layers simply omit it

visa_sponsorship.description: Job-only. Present only when the posting text is explicit — true if it offers visa sponsorship, false if it states none is available. Absent when unstated

degree_required.description: Job-only. Present only when the posting text is explicit — true if a degree is required, false if it explicitly says none is needed. Absent when unstated

relocation.description: Job-only. Present only when the posting text explicitly offers relocation assistance (true) or explicitly rules it out (false). Absent when unstated

salary.description: Job-only. A literal pay range lifted verbatim from the posting (scripts/patterns.py parse_salary). Absent unless the posting itself discloses a currency-marked two-ended range that passes sanity checks — never estimated
